lifecycleDiagnostics.scope: Diagnostic correlation only; focus/lifecycle/long-task timing cannot identify the cause of a rendering gap. Clock, visibility and safety acceptance are unchanged.

attributionDiagnostics.scope: Bounded synchronous authoring phase spans and supported long-animation-frame caller attribution. Overlap, maxima and script entry points do not identify a slow descendant, garbage collection, browser scheduling or GPU completion. No acceptance changes.
limitations: No sampled JS call stacks, allocation or GC events; use a native browser performance trace to attribute a descendant or GC.
LoAF observes same-origin main-thread entry points only; worker/extension/cross-origin work may be absent.
The terminal frame may not have reached the observer queue at stop; takeRecords drains only entries already available.
Nested or asynchronous work may share a frame. Phase durations are synchronous wall spans, not exclusive CPU.

Overlap associations retain the phase window at observer receipt; discarded history makes counts lower bounds and unfinished overlaps remain unknown. Later snapshots do not reconstruct or complete earlier evidence.
No raw invoker strings, foreign origins/paths, query/hash credentials or window references retained.

observerCPU.scope: Synchronous frame checks, sample collection and bounded live JSON/text submission only. Excludes asynchronous observer callbacks, final/export serialization, browser layout, GPU completion and garbage collection attribution.

limitations: Repeated authored Urban road/court circuit, not all worlds, indoor routes or player behavior
CPU submission is not GPU completion or physical-device FPS
Resource counters exclude opaque engine/GPU allocations
Imported segments are unverified history and never extend an uninterrupted pass
No persistence, browser-restart or all-network-offline claim
Source payload is fully verified before timing; no network latency is exercised during the measured segment
